name: night-mr-btc-wf
_comment: Walk-forward sweep of the night mean-reversion bot. Pipeline demo, not a strategy proposal.
The range stops at 2026-02 on purpose: docs/strategy-ideas.md reserves March-August 2026 as
out-of-sample and it must not be touched until a candidate has already survived everything here.
base    - a normal run declaration, exactly as npm run backtest takes it. costs are mandatory.
grid    - what to vary. A list of values, or {from,to,step}, or {from,to,count}.
Every key is checked against the bot's parameters, so a typo fails instead of
walkForward - trainDays fits, testDays judges, stepDays moves the window. mode rolling keeps
the training window a fixed length; anchored grows it from the start of the range.
objective - what a fold's winner maximises: sharpe | profitFactor | netProfit | netProfitPct |
minTrainTrades - a combination with fewer trades in a training window cannot be selected.
This is the main defence against a fold being won by four lucky trades.
